subject.title: Blocking hook for skill/workspace injection (before_skill_load) - enables external integrity tooling

question: Should context-source integrity become a supported plugin SDK contract, and should it extend `before_agent_run` or introduce a dedicated per-source blocking hook?
rationale: The missing metadata is confirmed, but choosing a permanent public hook boundary affects compatibility, hot-path performance, failure semantics, and every agent harness.

options.title: Extend final-run gate
options.body: Add immutable workspace and skill source records with paths and digests to `before_agent_run`, retaining one blocking checkpoint before model input.

options.title: Add per-source gate
options.body: Introduce a dedicated blocking hook during source capture when early vetoes materially avoid prompt construction or memory costs.

options.title: Retain trust model
options.body: Decline the SDK addition and document that integrity of trusted local skill and workspace files remains an operator responsibility.

recommendation.title: Extend final-run gate
recommendation.body: Add immutable workspace and skill source records with paths and digests to `before_agent_run`, retaining one blocking checkpoint before model input.

likelyOwner.reason: Kaspre has the strongest available recent-history connection to the central plugin hook runner where this contract would be defined.
